# The Hollowed (see their spec).
# 1. The nearest camp (/locate: its chunk's corner, -544 624 in the dev world, so its middle is at
#    -536 632), generated by loading its chunks: the obelisk on its crying obsidian at the middle,
#    the north tent's purple ridge and, under it, the chest (all found with "positioned over", which
#    stands on the topmost block of each column).
# 2. Its people (summoned: a camp only wakes for a player) are kept strong by the obelisk (their
#    effects logged: regeneration and resistance); the obelisk broken by command, they're weakened
#    (logged again: weakness and slowness); then the obelisk is set back, for the next run.
# 3. Hunger's harm on a husk; the server settings list Hollowed patrols.
locate structure elementalarcana:hollowed_camp
gamerule doMobSpawning false
forceload add -560 608 -513 655
sleep 4
execute positioned -536 0 632 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves if block ~ ~-1 ~ elementalarcana:hunger_obelisk
execute positioned -536 0 632 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves if block ~ ~-2 ~ minecraft:crying_obsidian
execute positioned -536 0 625 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves if block ~ ~-1 ~ minecraft:purple_wool
execute positioned -536 0 624 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves if block ~ ~-3 ~ minecraft:chest
execute positioned -533 0 634 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves run summon elementalarcana:hollowed_acolyte ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["hw"],PersistenceRequired:1b}
execute positioned -539 0 634 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves run summon elementalarcana:hollowed_devourer ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["hw"],PersistenceRequired:1b}
execute positioned -536 0 635 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves run summon elementalarcana:hollow_herald ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["hw"],PersistenceRequired:1b}
sleep 4
execute as @e[tag=hw] run data get entity @s active_effects
execute positioned -536 0 632 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves run setblock ~ ~-1 ~ minecraft:air
sleep 1
execute as @e[tag=hw] run data get entity @s active_effects
execute positioned -536 0 632 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves run setblock ~ ~ ~ elementalarcana:hunger_obelisk
execute positioned -536 0 638 positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves run summon minecraft:husk ~ ~ ~ {NoAI:1b,Tags:["hw_husk"],PersistenceRequired:1b}
damage @e[tag=hw_husk,limit=1] 4 elementalarcana:hollowed
kill @e[tag=hw]
kill @e[tag=hw_husk]
arcana config
forceload remove all
